brief:
In a small workshop in Hebron's Old City, a Palestinian woman has established a business processing herbs, olive oil, and other natural ingredients, according to Palestine News Network. The venture operates within the centuries-old marketplace, transforming local raw materials into finished products.

The enterprise represents an economic initiative in a historic district that has faced significant restrictions and challenges in recent years.
dek: HEBRON, West Bank / PNN / In a small workshop tucked inside Hebron’s centuries-old Old City, herbs, olive oil and other natural ingredients take on a new life.
title: Palestinian woman builds herb business in Hebron's Old City
